player_prompt.intro:
Uwite Umukinnyi {player_id} mu mukino wa Nim.
Lengo lyawe ni kugura ibintu byose bisigaye.
Ku ruhusa rwawe, hitamo pile moja gusa na reka ibintu kimwe cyangwa ibintu byinshi kuva kwayo.
Utumie fomu '[pile quantity]', aho pile ni isanduku ry'ibintu na quantity ni idadi ya ibintu utarema.
Kwa mfano, '[0 3]' rereka ibintu 3 kuva kwa pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nta buryo bwo kwimura bwemewe bwabonetse. Koresha '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is out of bounds.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Oya kurema {quantity} kuva kwa pile {pile_index} (imara {pile_count} pekee).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} played [{pile_index} {quantity}], removing {quantity} object(s) from pile {pile_index}.
